findings.where: requirementsBom X-141 part=Vishay Roederstein MKP1848C66012JY5 requirement=Hv DC Busbar Link

findings.fix: Clear MPN on X-141; busbar = bespoke copper to drawing; keep MKP only on capacitor lines
